static_traits.name: 柯凯
static_traits.social_status: 与not理解行业压力的朋友保持距离；在模特行业有少数朋友可交流，但not yet向其透露自尊问题
static_traits.medical_history: 18岁曾患泌尿系统癌症并痊愈；without心理治疗或心理问题既往史；目前健康状况Good
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous at the first session, but high cooperation, clear expression, coherent logic, a positive attitude, and willingness to try cognitive restructuring

basic_info.main_problem: Repeatedly frustrated in maintaining a low-carb diet, frequently engages in negative self-labeling because of dietary mistakes (such as 'I am a weak coward'), affecting confidence and professional focus.
basic_info.core_demands: 我想在犯错时not再把自己当失败者，重建自信，好让我专注于事业。
growth_experiences: 18岁时罹患泌尿系统癌症并战胜疾病，此后身体保持健康，without心理治疗史。

After entering the Hollywood modeling industry, in recent months under a high-pressure environment, finding it hard to persistently follow a low-carb diet plan; after dietary slips, negative self-labels and self-criticism frequently appear, gradually affecting professional focus and daily self-care.

special_situations.event: 每次偏离低碳饮食计划（例如吃了not在计划内的食物）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完全、持续地遵守饮食计划，就说明我have not意志力、I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to control diet more strictly, seeks comfort and reassurance from others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我have not意志力，我是懦弱的胆小鬼

special_situations.event: Seeing peer friends or colleagues who seem to 'all stick to the plan and be in good shape'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人都能做到而我做not到，就证明我not如他们、not适合这个行业
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，我not适合做模特

special_situations.event: In high-pressure stages such as auditions or work preparation, dietary adherence becomes harder
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 真正适合这行的人在压力下也能完美自律；如果我做not到，我就永远not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pressures oneself with negative labels, seeks others' assurance

special_situations.event: After a dietary slip-up in front of friends or colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们看到我的失误，他们会看not起我，认为我not用
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Contacts friends less, avoids social settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得I am a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen as a disciplined, successful person (to gain acceptance from the industry and peers)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与not完美会招致他人的轻视与排斥，从而被negate价值
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control and avoids failure through harsh self-demands and self-criticism
Avoids socializing以降低被评价的风险
寻求他人保证以暂时缓解not安与羞耻感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、随时可能失败的弱者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻挑剔、随时会negate自己的评判者（同伴/行业）
not理解行业压力的旁观者/朋友

manifestations: 与not理解行业压力的朋友保持距离
Negative self-labels weaken the sense of self-worth and purpose
Finds it hard to see effort and progress after setbacks

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulse originally intended to be expressed or sought outward, and instead does it to herself (turning energy from outward to inward).
manifestations: After a diet slip, turns stress and frustration into harsh self-criticism and negative labels
Reduces communication with others and internalizes emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 担心他人会看not起自己，把自我羞耻感归因于“他们会negate我”
在他人看起来状态Good时，假定他们对自己有负面看法

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与过度自我限制和苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎。
manifestations: 频繁use自我贬损的语言（如“我have not意志力”）
在社交与职业情境中过度自我评估，导致Withdrawal

positive_force: Has clear desire and drive toward career goals
Willing to seek help and try cognitive restructuring and self-compassion exercises
Positive attitude toward counseling, able to notice and willing to record negative automatic thoughts
Has a few peer resources in the industry to talk with
negative_force: Black-and-white thinking that binds self-worth to perfect self-discipline

Social avoidance导致支持减少与Loneliness感增加

target_behavior.behavior: Harsh negative self-labeling and self-criticism after a dietary slip
antecedent: In high-pressure phases like audition/work preparation
Comparison arises after seeing peers stick to their plans
target_behavior.core_reason: Binds self-worth to perfect self-discipline; catastrophizes failure in order to gain industry recognition, lacking self-compassion
target_behavior.function: Tries to strengthen self-control through self-punishment while avoiding shame and disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged self-confidence、Decreased motivation、工作专注度降低、情绪波动加剧

target_behavior.consequence: Developing dependence on others' reassurance, long-term difficulty in establishing stable self-worth, negative self-labels persist
